name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: HBD tabs: a role=tablist navigation built on Radix Tabs with the legacy .hbd-* BEM classes re-applied to Root/List/Trigger/Content (className + asChild) so the de-shadowed tabs.css renders 1:1, including the active 'ribbon' indicator (.hbd-tabs__tab::before driven by --hbd-tabs-indicator-*). Horizontal/vertical orientation, roving-tabindex keyboard (arrows follow orientation, Home/End), aria-selected/controls/labelledby, lazy (Radix unmount) or eager (forceMount) panel mode, optional count badge, and a scrollable overflow variant with JS scroll-prev/next buttons + scroll-into-view. Controlled-first via value + onValueChange (legacy hbd:change { value } detail), with defaultValue uncontrolled fallback. Compound members TabsList / TabsTrigger / TabsContent (+ optional TabsPanels).
